note: Adapted from the English redescription of this species in Bacchus (1997); the alate, soldier and large worker are all described in prose, with measurement tables, and a lectotype is designated here (lectotype; original description by Fuller 1922). The author notes that the alate resembles mulii and baginei, the soldier edwini, kairoonae and chomaensis, and the worker darlingtonae.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head orange-yellow to orange, with many small pale dots scattered at the setal bases; anteclypeus pale yellow; postclypeus pale yellow to yellow; antennal segments yellow, brownish on both sides, segments 1 and 2 darker; labrum yellow; pronotum usually slightly paler than the head capsule; abdominal tergites yellowish brown, sternites slightly paler; tibiae yellow, slightly darker than the femora. Posterior part of head capsule almost semicircular. Setae numerous above the compound eyes, fewer behind them, not extending beyond the eye bulge. Frontal gland pore not visible; central spot oval. Frons smooth. Cranial suture incomplete. Compound eyes and ocelli oval; postclypeus with a distinct median suture. Labrum width greater than length; antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 shortest, segments 2 and 4 about equal in size, segment 1 larger. Pronotum with numerous setae and a white pale cross-shaped marking, anterior and posterior margins slightly concave. Posterior margins of meso- and metanota moderately incurved. Wings short, less than half the combined body and head length.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule and labrum yellow to orange-yellow; mandibles brown with yellow bases; antennae pale yellow, segments 1 and 2 slightly darker; postmentum yellow, concolorous with the genae; thoracic nota, abdomen and legs pale yellow. Head capsule short-oval, sides with numerous regularly and symmetrically arranged setae; posterior margin evenly rounded. Labrum ligulate, apex extending past the middle of the mandibles, with 8—10 setae. Mandibles nearly straight, curvature 0.04 mm. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 shortest, segments 1 and 2 subequal. Postmentum short and broad. Anterior margin of pronotum slightly concave, posterior margin nearly straight. Fore tibia not inflated; spurs 3, the dorsal spur almost as long as the outer ventral spur; the large seta on the front of the fore coxa not spine-like.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Large worker: head capsule yellow; antennae, body and legs pale yellow; postclypeal pad distinctly yellowish brown. Head capsule subrectangular, sides almost parallel, posterior margin broadly rounded; setae on the sides sparse; fork of the cranial suture incomplete; postclypeus inflated, very flat bean-shaped, median suture distinct; anteclypeus flat, projecting in the middle. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 slightly smaller than segment 4, segments 1 and 2 subequal; postmentum with a few long setae; labrum with a transverse sclerotic band, apex broadly rounded. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin with a broad shallow V-shaped notch in the middle, posterior margin nearly straight. Fore tibia not inflated; the large seta on the front of the fore coxa not spine-like, the dorsal spur almost as long as the ventral spur.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Alate measurements (6 heads, 5 colonies, mm): head length to anterior margin of postclypeus 1.03—1.08, head width including compound eyes 1.10—1.23, postclypeus length 0.28—0.30, width 0.54—0.57, labrum length 0.25—0.33, width 0.43—0.45, maximum diameter of compound eye 0.33—0.40, minimum diameter 0.28—0.35, maximum diameter of ocellus 0.13—0.15, minimum diameter 0.08—0.13, distance from ocellus to compound eye 0.03—0.05, pronotum length 0.65—0.75, width 1.05—1.15, hind tibia length 1.15—1.25. Soldier measurements (4 heads, 4 colonies): head length including mandibles 1.15—1.23, head length to mandible base 0.75—0.80, head width behind antennal sockets 0.58—0.65, maximum head width 0.60—0.68, labrum length 0.20—0.25, width 0.18—0.20, left mandible transverse length 0.45—0.48, curvature 0.04, fore tibia length 0.45, width 0.10—0.13, hind tibia length 0.53—0.55, maximum pronotum width 0.40—0.45, postmentum length 0.40, width 0.30. Large-worker measurements (4 heads, 4 colonies): head length to anterior margin of postclypeus 0.88—0.93, maximum head width 0.73—0.78, postclypeal pad length 0.18—0.21, width 0.33—0.35, maximum pronotum width 0.40—0.45, fore tibia length 0.40—0.45, hind tibia length 0.45—0.50. Lectotype alate (South Africa, NCI, designated here). Original description from thickets at Pienaars River, Transvaal, South Africa; collecting records include nests inside Macrotermes mounds and subterranean nests.
